subject: Remove duplicate definition of UNUSED(V) (#755)
reason: The change only deletes a duplicate `#define UNUSED(V)` macro inside the `#ifdef SERVER_TEST` section of src/dict.c. The identical macro remains defined elsewhere, and this block is only compiled for the server's internal unit tests, not for normal builds. No command, reply, replication, persistence or cluster behaviour changes, so there is nothing for a fuzzer scenario to reach.
